content.short: Bittensor is a decentralized AI network that creates a global marketplace for machine learning and intelligence.
content.description:
Bittensor is an open-source protocol that powers a decentralized, peer-to-peer machine learning network where intelligence is treated as a tradable commodity. The platform is organized into specialized "subnets," each dedicated to specific AI tasks such as text generation, data scraping, or image synthesis. By decentralizing the production and distribution of artificial intelligence, Bittensor aims to create a more accessible and collaborative environment for AI development outside the control of large corporations.

The network uses the TAO token to incentivize participation, rewarding "Miners" who provide high-quality AI outputs and "Validators" who assess the quality of those contributions. This meritocratic system ensures that the most valuable models receive the greatest rewards, driving continuous innovation across the network. As a Layer 1 blockchain specifically built for AI, Bittensor represents a major shift in how machine intelligence is developed, valued, and shared on a global scale.
